body.message:
I am interested in renting a fully furnished luxury apartment and would appreciate your help finding the right property.
My requirements:
* Location: Palm Jumeirah is my first choice. I may consider other areas  only if the property offers a genuinely high-end standard of luxury  quality and finishes matter more than location for alternatives.
* Size: 2 bedrooms / 2 bathrooms minimum
* View: Sea view preferred
* Rental period: January 2027 to mid-April 2027 (approximately 3.5 months)
* Budget: Up to AED 40,000/month (utilities ideally included)
Important: I hold a valid UAE Golden Visa and Emirates ID, so the rental contract can be formally registered with Ejari — this is a strict requirement for me.
Could you please let me know if the property listed in your ad is available for this period and whether Ejari registration is possible for a short-term contract of this duration?
Thank you and I look forward to hearing from you.
Best regards, Nicola Pollastri
